author: RightSide
body:
Well after getting told my last map was terrible and we don't need any more TDM maps I went and got together with some of my other map making friends who don't play of Avicus :( And they gave me lots of new ideas and helped build some and here it is ! 

ANY SUGGESTIONS COMMENT BELOW AND ILL TRY AND ADD THEM !

 Different Features:
  • Longer Map
  • Now DTM 2 monuments per team
  • No OP sword
  • Unfinished bridge in the middle for player to finish it and get to the 2 diamond blocks in the middle !
  • Different inventory
  • No lava
  • Small amount of Iron added
  • Added Arch (BoycalledJack suggested it)
  • Punch bow added
  • Tried not to use laggy blocks and entites Example lava, buttons tall buildings)
  • And little things added and improved !
  • Added some trees
  • Added lots of new structures 
Images : http://imgur.com/a/0Adb6
YML : Needs writing
Download : http://www.mediafire.com/download/d79izpou83o90iw/Vega+By+ElementProHD+%282%29.zip
Map by ElementProHD help from couple of friends !

replies.author: Fouled
replies.body:
[Denied] Your map has been denied and will not appear in the Avicus repository or the rotations. You can still fix up your map, with the problems that are currently active. Your map was denied for these reasons...
- Too simple. The aesthetics factor on structures and terrain isn't very pleasing and doesn't provide a huge "wow factor". The monuments look like they took no effort to make, which can be improved. Try adding some more detail onto the structures, and add some different block variations to the map!
- Land mass surroundings. The map has a patch of grass surrounding it. People can easily bridge over to that area and get across the map fast. Try to remove that! :)
- The size of the map is a bit too small. Try expanding on the map to make it even bigger. This would improve the maps game-play by alot! 

You can fix up these small problems and re-submit the map if you wish!
Good luck and awesome work so far! :D
